note: What scripts/collect.py reads every hour. One entry per feed URL: domain is the site as GDELT names it (its SourceCommonName), kind is rss (Atom too) or sitemap (a Google News sitemap), section is a label. An entry with enabled false is kept for the record, with why. An entry with robots ignore is fetched without the robots.txt check, on Alex's decision, recorded in its note. Verified 2026-09-13 with scripts/collect.py --feed; scripts/discover.py finds more; the entries after the four controls came from its run over the 300 lost outlets from the box on 2026-09-13 (newsrooms only: aggregators, press-release wires, radio-station shells and non-English sites left out). The four control sites at the end are still in GDELT, so that what a sitemap yields can be measured against what GDELT saw of the same site.
